declarations.code: static bool eq_int_type(int_type c1, int_type c2);

intro:
Checks whether two values of type int_type are equal.

See CharTraits for the general requirements on character traits for X::eq_int_type.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if c1 is equal to c2, false otherwise.
